name: PrincipalPayment
description: Any kind of principal payments when the amount is known and thus fixed.

discountFactor.description: The value representing the discount factor used to calculate the present value of the principal payment amount.

payerReceiver.description: Specifies the parties responsible for making and receiving payments defined by this structure.

presentValuePrincipalAmount.description: The amount representing the present value of the principal payment.

principalAmount.description: When known at the time the transaction is made, the cash amount to be paid.

principalPaymentDate.description: The date where the PrincipalPayment shall be settled.
